enabled.description:
Enable metric and tracing collection
@default false

queues.copilot.description:
The config for copilot job queue
@default {"concurrency":10}

queues.calendar.description:
The config for calendar job queue
@default {"concurrency":4}

queues.doc.description:
The config for doc job queue
@default {"concurrency":1}

queues.indexer.description:
The config for indexer job queue
@default {"concurrency":1}

queues.notification.description:
The config for notification job queue
@default {"concurrency":10}

queues.nightly.description:
The config for nightly job queue
@default {"concurrency":1}

queues.backendRuntime.description:
The config for backend runtime job queue
@default {"concurrency":1}

queues.inviteAbuse.description:
The config for invite abuse disposition job queue
@default {"concurrency":1}

enabled.description:
Whether the throttler is enabled.
@default true

throttlers.default.description:
The config for the default throttler.
@default {"ttl":60000,"limit":120}

throttlers.strict.description:
The config for the strict throttler.
@default {"ttl":60000,"limit":20}

allowSignupForOauth.description:
Whether allow new registrations via configured oauth.
@default true

requireEmailDomainVerification.description:
Whether require email domain record verification before accessing restricted resources.
@default false

requireEmailVerification.description:
Whether require email verification before accessing restricted resources(not implemented).
@default true

newAccountShareActionDelay.description:
Minimum account age in seconds before new accounts can invite members or create share links.
@default 86400

trustedCloudflareHeaders.description:
Whether request abuse source facts should trust Cloudflare headers from the origin edge.
@default false

inviteQuotaShadowMode.description:
Whether workspace invite quota should record would-block decisions without rejecting requests or executing abuse actions.
@default false

inviteQuotaFailOpenOnRuntimeError.description:
Whether workspace invite quota should fail open when native runtime admission is unavailable. Keep disabled for production.
@default false

passwordRequirements.description:
The password strength requirements when set new password.
@default {"min":8,"max":32}

session.ttl.description:
Application auth expiration time in seconds.
@default 1296000

session.ttr.description:
Application auth time to refresh in seconds.
@default 604800

token.accessTokenTtl.description:
Access JWT expiration time in seconds.
@default 900

token.refreshIdleTtl.description:
Auth refresh session inactivity expiration in seconds.
@default 2592000

token.refreshAbsoluteTtl.description:
Auth refresh session absolute expiration in seconds.
@default 15552000

token.refreshGracePeriod.description:
One-use refresh rotation concurrency grace period in seconds.
@default 30

token.refreshRetention.description:
Retention for expired auth refresh generations in seconds.
@default 2592000

fallbackDomains.description:
The emails from these domains are always sent using the fallback SMTP server.
@default []

deliveryWorker.batchSize.description:
Number of mail delivery rows claimed by each worker tick.
@default 50

deliveryWorker.leaseMs.description:
Mail delivery worker lease duration in milliseconds.
@default 120000

deliveryWorker.retentionDays.description:
Days to retain anonymized terminal mail delivery ledger rows.
@default 30

fallbackSMTP.name.description:
Hostname used for fallback SMTP HELO/EHLO (e.g. mail.example.com). Leave empty to use the system hostname.
@default ""

fallbackSMTP.host.description:
Host of the email server (e.g. smtp.gmail.com)
@default ""

fallbackSMTP.port.description:
Port of the email server (they commonly are 25, 465 or 587)
@default 465

fallbackSMTP.username.description:
Username used to authenticate the email server
@default ""

fallbackSMTP.password.description:
Password used to authenticate the email server
@default ""

fallbackSMTP.sender.description:
Sender of all the emails (e.g. "LocalMind Self Hosted <noreply@example.com>")
@default ""

fallbackSMTP.ignoreTLS.description:
Whether ignore email server's TLS certificate verification. Enable it for self-signed certificates.
@default false

experimental.yocto.description:
Use `y-octo` to merge updates at the same time when merging using Yjs.
@default false

history.interval.description:
The minimum time interval in milliseconds of creating a new history snapshot when doc get updated.
@default 600000

avatar.publicPath.description:
The public accessible path prefix for user avatars.
@default "/api/avatars/"

avatar.storage.description:
The config of storage for user avatars.
@default {"provider":"fs","bucket":"avatars","config":{"path":"~/.affine/storage"}}

name.description:
A recognizable name for the server. It will be shown when connected with LocalMind Desktop.
@default undefined

hosts.description:
Multiple hosts the server will accept requests from.
@default []

Whether allow guest users to create demo workspaces.
@default true

versionControl.enabled.description:
Whether check version of client before accessing the server.
@default false

Allowed version range of the app that allowed to access the server. Requires 'client/versionControl.enabled' to be true to take effect.
@default ">=0.25.0"

Check captcha challenge when user authenticating the app.
@default false

@default {"turnstile":{"secret":"","siteKey":"","action":"auth-sign-in"},"challenge":{"bits":20}}

enabled.description:
Whether to enable LocalMind AI.
Documentation: LocalMind AI deployment guide @default true

byok.enabled.description:
Allow instance administrators to manage AI provider credentials by workspace through Admin AI.
@default true

byok.allowedProviders.description:
AI providers that instance administrators may assign to workspaces through Admin AI.
@default ["openai","anthropic","gemini","fal"]

byok.allowCustomEndpoint.description:
Allow administrator-managed workspace AI credentials to use a custom provider endpoint.
@default false

byok.allowPrivateEndpoint.description:
Whether administrator-managed workspace AI custom endpoints may resolve to private network targets. Enable only for trusted provider endpoints.
@default false

providers.profiles.description:
The profile list for copilot providers.
@default []

providers.defaults.description:
The default provider ids for model output types and global fallback.
@default {}

providers.routePolicy.description:
Config-driven provider route policy. Supports provider allow/block lists plus cloud/private_cloud/local privacy filters and preferences globally, per feature, or per workspace.
@default {}

prompts.overrides.description:
Config-driven prompt metadata overrides. Built-in prompt messages remain native fallback unless a later Prompt Registry layer replaces them.
@default []

prompts.defaults.description:
Global prompt model defaults for self-hosted deployments. The text bucket applies to text-like prompts, image/transcript apply to prompt category matches, and structured only applies to explicitly included structured prompts. Prompt overrides remain the more specific policy.
@default {}

tasks.models.description:
Optional task model aliases for embedding, workspace indexing, and rerank. Leave empty to let provider defaults and modelDefinitions choose task routes.
@default {}

supportBundles.objectStorageWebhooks.description:
Production object-storage webhooks for support bundle direct-download completion notifications. Each entry verifies raw webhook bodies with HMAC-SHA256 before forwarding provider event evidence into the durable transfer queue.
@default []

enterpriseCli.allowedProviders.description:
Enterprise CLI providers that users may connect. Instance administrators own this allowlist.
@default ["WECOM","LARK","DINGTALK"]

enterpriseCli.allowedToolsByProvider.description:
Exact Enterprise CLI tool names that LocalMind AI may use for each provider. Use * only when the instance administrator explicitly accepts the full discovered catalog.
@default {"wecom":[],"lark":[],"dingtalk":[]}

mcpDelegation.callbackAllowedOrigins.description:
Exact callback origins that may use HTTP or private network targets for LocalMind MCP delegation events. Keep empty unless a trusted local caller such as SparkClaw requires it.
@default []

The config for OpenAI-compatible endpoints such as OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM and LocalAI.
